title: Calendar event
description: An event with a date, place and optional repeat.

start_at.title: Starts
start_at.description: When the event starts, in the site time zone unless a time zone is set below.

end_at.title: Ends
end_at.description: When the event ends. Leave empty for an event without an end time.

all_day.title: All day
all_day.description: The event lasts whole days and has no start time.

time_zone.title: Time zone
time_zone.description: Optional IANA name such as Europe/London that overrides the site time zone for this event.

event_status.title: Status
event_status.description: Cancelled and postponed events stay listed and are marked as such.

online_url.title: Online link
online_url.description: Link to join the event online.

venue.title: Venue
venue.description: Choose a venue. Its address is used for the map.

venue_name.title: Venue name
venue_name.description: Used when no venue is chosen.

venue_address.title: Venue address
venue_address.description: Street address, used when no venue is chosen.

venue_city.title: Venue city
venue_city.description: Used when no venue is chosen.

series.title: Series
series.description: The series this event belongs to.

ticket_url.title: Ticket link
ticket_url.description: Where to book or buy tickets.

website.title: Event website
website.description: A page with more about the event.

price.title: Price
price.description: Text shown to visitors, for example Free or From 12.

price_amount.title: Price amount
price_amount.description: Number used to tell free from paid events. Use 0 for free.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three letter code in capitals, for example EUR.

featured.title: Featured
featured.description: Show this event first where lists support it.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Free words that describe the event.

repeat_every.title: Every
repeat_every.description: Repeat every this many days, weeks, months or years.

repeat_by.title: Monthly by
repeat_by.description: Repeat on the same day of the month or on the same weekday.

repeat_nth.title: Which weekday
repeat_nth.description: 1 to 5 for the first to fifth, -1 for the last.

repeat_until.title: Ends on
repeat_until.description: Last day the event can repeat.

repeat_count.title: Ends after
repeat_count.description: Number of times the event happens.

repeat_skip_dates.title: Skipped dates
repeat_skip_dates.description: Days the event does not happen.

repeat_overrides.title: Changed dates
repeat_overrides.description: Managed by the repeating events page. Format: date|start|end, for example 2026-12-01|19:00|20:00 (end optional).

source_uid.title: Source ID
source_uid.description: The identifier of the event at its source, used to avoid duplicates.

source_url.title: Source link
source_url.description: Page of the event at its source.
